findings.title: K-rules DRU reader misses three spellings KiCad honours: unquoted rule names, quoted layer names and #-commented rules

evidence.unit_probe: .supervisor/r23_gate/probe/dru_spell.py on the committed DRU text: (rule relief (layer inner) ... hole_clearance (min 0.25mm)) 0 issues; (rule relief (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.10mm))) 0 issues (not even the 0.20 mm floor); (layer "In1.Cu") 0.25 mm, (layer "inner") 0.25 mm, (layer "F.Cu") 0.21 mm each 0 issues; the same rules with a quoted name / bare layer word give 1+ issues (control). Commenting out the pinned rule "JLC inner-layer PTH pad hole to copper" with # on every line: 0 issues (the table still finds it, KiCad ignores it; the committed DRU itself starts with # comment lines that KiCad accepts).
evidence.kicad_acceptance: h01 (unquoted rule name relief, via hole_clearance 0.10 mm for non-zone copper): KiCad 10.0.7 DRC 0 violations with the seeded 0.16 mm drawing, which DRC flags (hole_clearance 0.25 rule, actual 0.1600 mm) without the rule (h01c control). h06 (rule "quoted layer probe" with (layer "In1.Cu"), 1.0 mm): DRC reports 130 hole_clearance violations naming that rule, so KiCad reads a quoted layer.
evidence.full_gate_seed: h01_unq_relief_graphic: generator r10_sch.py appends the unquoted rule, DRU regenerated and DRU_SHA256 re-pinned; an In1 GND board copper drawing (0.2 mm line) 0.16 mm from the hole wall of via 3V3 (36.13, 58.80), under JLC "Inner layer via hole to copper clearance 0.2mm". After the post-board regeneration (budget, hot-plug, orient / export / bind / verify, binding note: all exit 0) every check.sh checker step exits 0: drc, audit, silk, parts, fit, check_r10 (K-rules OK, 36/36), route_check, fab --content.
evidence.control: h01b: the same seed with a quoted rule name fails K-rules with 4 table issues (floor 0.20 and three overrides).
evidence.jlc: https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities (read 2026-11-01): "Inner layer via hole to copper clearance: 0.2mm"

findings.impact: A reviewed, re-pinned DRU can lower any JLC hole row with a rule KiCad applies but K-rules does not read (unquoted name: every row and the 0.20 mm floor; quoted layer: the inner and outer PTH overrides). On its own the board measures still hold most rows; together with R23-GATE-02 a 0.16 mm via-hole-to-copper gap passes the whole gate (h01).
findings.concrete_fix: Checks only: parse rules with an s-expression reader that strips # comment lines first and accepts a quoted or bare rule name and layer token (strip quotes before dru_layers_meet); fail K-rules on any (rule token it cannot parse. Seeds: h01 / the dru_spell.py cases.

findings.title: JLC board measures (pth_inner_copper, jlc_board_holes) skip copper drawings, copper text and footprint zones

evidence.file: tools/check_r10.py _copper_items: board.Zones(), board.GetTracks() and pads only; copper_nodes (used by S-8, K-power) also takes board and footprint PCB_SHAPE copper, copper text / fields and footprint zones
evidence.seed: h01b: with the 0.16 mm In1 GND drawing beside via 3V3 (36.13, 58.80) K-rules reports only the 4 DRU-table issues, no "via ... hole wall" issue; in h01 (DRU table blind, R23-GATE-01) K-rules is OK. NPTH-to-copper, PTH-to-outer and PTH-to-inner rows read the same item list.
evidence.board_now: No copper drawing or copper text on 5516eeec near a hole (DRC clean), so the board is not affected today.

findings.impact: D-R22-01 / -05's claim 'measured on the board whatever the DRU says' holds only for tracks, vias, pads and board zones; any copper drawing or text is held by DRC alone, i.e. by the DRU the measures were meant to back up.

findings.title: DRU constraints other than the hole rows, and rule severity, are not floored: a re-pinned DRU drops copper clearance to 0.064 mm (under JLC 0.09 mm) and the gate passes

evidence.file: tools/check_r10.py k_rules: PRO_FLOORS / NETCLASS_CLEARANCE_FLOOR read the .kicad_pro only; jlc_hole_table reads only hole_clearance / hole_to_hole; no check of DRU clearance, track_width, edge_clearance, annular_width, via_diameter, text_height or (severity ...)
evidence.unit_probe: dru_spell.py: clearance 0.05, track_width 0.05, edge_clearance 0, annular_width 0.01, text_height 0.3, hole_size 0.1 and a (severity ignore) rule: 0 issues each
evidence.seeds: h04_clearance_below_floor: generator rule "Servo pair" clearance (min 0.05mm) on SERVO1_MCU, re-pinned; SERVO1_MCU F.Cu (30.3, 54.8)-(30.3, 73.2) widened 0.2 -> 0.38 mm, 0.0636 mm from SERVO2_MCU (DRC measure in control h03b: "netclass Default clearance 0.1500 mm; actual 0.0636 mm"). KiCad honours the DRU rule below the board-setup minimum 0.15 mm: DRC 0. h03_severity_ignore_servo: the same widening with a rule whose min stays 0.15 mm but carries (severity ignore): DRC 0. Both: regeneration all exit 0, every checker step exit 0 (K-rules OK, route_check 0 failing).
evidence.jlc: https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities: multilayer min trace width / spacing "0.09 / 0.09 mm (3.5 / 3.5 mil)"; "Copper clearance from routed board edges: >=0.2 mm"

findings.impact: K-rules' docstring says the design rules are 'not loosened (pyro safety rests on them)', but PRO_FLOORS are not a KiCad floor: one re-pinned DRU rule, or a (severity ignore) clause, silences DRC's clearance (and any other) test on chosen nets, including pyro nets, with no other checker holding general copper clearance.
findings.concrete_fix: Checks only: in k_rules, floor every DRU constraint minimum against PRO_FLOORS / JLC (clearance >= 0.15 except the named stricter rules, track_width >= 0.15, edge_clearance >= 0.5, annular_width >= 0.1, via_diameter >= 0.5, hole_size >= 0.3, text_height >= 1.0 on silk, ...), and reject any (severity ...) clause other than error; seeds h03 / h04.

findings.title: K-legends Fab rule misses footprint text boxes, visible footprint fields, squashed text and board-level Fab shapes

evidence.file: tools/check_r10.py fab_ref_crossings: fab_texts = isinstance(g, PCB_TEXT) over f.GraphicalItems() (PCB_TEXTBOX is a PCB_SHAPE, fields are not graphical items); only GetTextHeight() is floored; board-level drawings checked only for PCB_TEXT / PCB_TEXTBOX
seeds: f01b_fab_textbox_apart: a footprint PCB_TEXTBOX "Q121" (no border, mirrored, 0.6 mm) in Q120 on B.Fab at (13.5, 76.8), clear of every Fab outline: every checker step exit 0 (f01, the same box on Q120's body, fails only incidentally: the box joins Q120's outline and crosses its reference, 1.44 mm^2)

f02_value_visible: Q120's Value field (B.Fab, "AONR21357") made visible at Q120's centre: every step exit 0 (AGENTS section 3: part numbers hidden on F.Fab; D-R21-08: only ${REFERENCE} on the Fab layers)
f03_fab_ref_squash: R119's B.Fab reference character width 0.02 mm (height 0.40, stroke 0.06 kept): every step exit 0
f05_board_fab_cover: a board-level filled B.Fab rectangle 3.2 x 1.6 mm over R134's reference at (16.5, 64.0): every step exit 0
caught: f04 (R134 reference un-mirrored on B.Fab): DRC nonmirrored_text_on_back_layer

findings.impact: The bound assembly drawings (C84 is fitted by hand from them) can carry a wrong designator, a part number, an unreadable designator or a blacked-out one with the gate passing.
findings.concrete_fix: Checks only: treat PCB_TEXTBOX and every visible PCB_FIELD on a Fab layer as Fab text (only the one ${REFERENCE} text allowed); floor GetTextWidth() like the height (>= 0.5 x height, or FAB_REF_MIN_H); reject board-level PCB_SHAPEs on F.Fab / B.Fab (or test them against reference ink boxes). Seeds f01b, f02, f03, f05.

findings.title: r10_parts.py's own footprints are pinned only to their generator: a generator edit that strips the paste from Q120 / Q121 (the RAW_ACT load switch) passes the gate

evidence.file: m3_design/r10_parts.py load_switch() / geometry_checks() (pad positions and sizes only); tools/check_r10.py FOOTPRINT_SHA256 pins only the other footprints; LAND_OVERRIDES and paste_check compare the board with the library and the Gerbers with the board
evidence.seed: x02_gen_fet_no_paste: the copy's r10_parts.py load_switch() pads 1-9 lose F.Paste; r10_parts --library-only regenerates kilib (M3_AONR21357_DFN3x3A_EP1: 9 -> 0 paste layers); Q120 / Q121's 18 pads on the board lose B.Paste to match. Regeneration all exit 0; every checker step exit 0; the bound package reads "B_Paste 357 flashes on 357 pasted pads" (375 in the committed package and in AGENTS / docs).
evidence.related: x01_gen_db125_drill (terminal() drill 1.3 -> 1.0 mm, against DORABO T0-1's 1.3 mm) fails only incidentally (K-reference, after the refill); no check holds the DB125 drill.

findings.impact: The fire-path P-FETs (and any other r10_parts land: DB125 drills, GH2, TPS7A91, C84, SRP5030, microSD) can lose paste, drill or mask through a generator edit and the gate passes; JLC would place Q120 / Q121 on dry pads.
findings.concrete_fix: Checks only: pin r10_parts' generated .kicad_mod files in FOOTPRINT_SHA256 (as K-lands does for the others), or pin each generated footprint's paste / mask layers and drill in geometry_checks; also pin the paste totals (253 / 375) in the fab content check.

findings.title: SINGLE_OPEN_TAPS still omits single-via grounds and regulator pins of flight-relevant ICs: U4's only power-ground via and the MCU's VCAP capacitors

evidence.probe: .supervisor/r23_gate/probe/single_via_all.py: every pad that one via open cuts off from its net's main copper (copper_nodes + _copper_adjacency, as single_via_opens)
rows: GND via (16.75, 47.60), B.Cu/In1/F.Cu: cuts U4.6 and U4.7 (ISM6HG256X pins 6 / 7, 'GND, 0 V supply', DS14623 Rev 1 pin table p10, same map as DS15034 per parts_qualification.md); U4.2 / U4.3 (SDx / SCx, 'connect to VDDIO or GND') stay on GND by another path. Open: the IMU's supply ground floats (behaviour not stated by ST: Inference); the accelerometer is the launch-detect input
VCAP1 via (29.25, 38.00): cuts C19.1 from U1's VCAP pin; VCAP2 via (18.00, 37.30): cuts C20.1 (open: the core regulator loses its output capacitor; MCU behaviour Inference)
GND via (19.35, 59.30): Q123.2 (buzzer driver source, annunciation only); GND via (29.14, 49.25): C21.2 (3V3A bypass); GND via (13.75, 24.10): C28.2
none of these is a SINGLE_OPEN_TAPS entry or a recorded single point (grep of docs and R10_DECISIONS for the coordinates)

findings.impact: D-R22-02 applied 'the via is the IC's only ground' to the two TPS2553s only; the same open on U4's ground or a VCAP capacitor is a silent single point for flight sensing / the MCU core, unrecorded and ungated.
findings.concrete_fix: Checks only now: add (GND, U4.6 / U4.7, J1.2), (VCAP1, C19.1, U1 VCAP), (VCAP2, C20.1, U1 VCAP) as taps with exact SINGLE_OPEN_EXCEPTIONS entries and measured reasons, and record them with the next-board-change second vias; the board change itself waits for the next respin.
